text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock D, then later buying it again, suggests I need a clear thesis and portfolio role before trading rather than reacting to short-term moves.","Several sells locked in sizeable losses, so I should review whether the original reasons for holding still apply and use predefined risk rules—not my cost basis or the urge to avoid a loss.","My account’s month-to-month gains and losses do not establish skill; I should track performance over a longer period against a suitable market benchmark and account for risk."]}
